title: Review of c43's CIPS consumer: with consumption switched off and catalysis kept, the consumers do not die (31 -> 39); E is presence, not consumption, and the consumer divides only with its prey
summary: Fresh seed 72 (labkit, the claim's settings: 128^2, t=12000, --frames 120 --lineage-k 5, world.py unchanged): consumer caps form from noise on prey droplets as in the claim (about 27-31 bodies; 19 persistent splits, generation 5; prey 71 persistent splits, generation 10). Fresh seed 71 diverged at frame 1 (q overflows within 225 steps; seeds 57, 72 and 73 do not), so the default step is marginal on some seeds. L4c consumption-not-presence arm (ctrl_world.py: the consumption yield y2 set to 0 from t=3000; catalysis, product r and the drift up r unchanged, prey left in place): the consumers do not dissolve but grow in number, 31 at t=3000 to 39 at t=12000 (fed run 27), as white dots fixed on prey droplets, and the prey stop dividing and settle into a lattice of 59 droplets. The consumer needs prey material as a catalytic substrate, not as food: the claim's E fork (removing all prey) tests presence. c55's pairtest on seed 72: 15 of 18 persistent consumer splits coincide with a prey split, consumers touch prey in a median 90% of frames, and 0 of 11 long consumer tracks touch 2 or more unrelated prey.

observations.S: rerun/seed72/sheet.png: t=0 is a noise field; prey droplets and consumer caps present by t=500
observations.E: ctrl_y2off/seed72 and analysis/y2off.png: with y2 = 0 from t=3000 (no prey material eaten, catalysis kept) consumers rise from 31 to 39 and persist to t=12000 (fed run 27): they do not depend on consuming prey
observations.D: analysis/pairtest_s72.json: 15 of 18 persistent consumer splits coincide with a prey split; consumers alone in a median 2.6% of frames; 0 of 11 long tracks touch >= 2 unrelated prey: the consumer divides as a cap of its dividing host
observations.I: rerun/seed72/sheet.png: the consumers are caps or bands on prey droplet edges (median 90% of frames touching prey), not free bodies

seeds_run.result: fail: non-finite fields at frame 1 (numerical divergence of q at the default dt; run71_nonfinite.log)
pass for S and the pack numbers (consumer 19 persistent splits, generation 5); E contradicted by the consumption-off arm; D joint with prey

controls_run.E: ctrl_y2off/seed72 (ctrl_world.py, y2cut_t 3000: consumption yield 0, catalysis and drift kept, prey in place)

not_checked: X (no consumer-free twin re-run; in the consumption-off arm the prey stop dividing, which suggests the claimed effect on prey works through eating)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed that ran (72); seed 71 diverged numerically, so the default step is unsafe on some seeds. The consumption-off arm is a world-level switch at t=3000, not a per-individual cut; it removes eating for all consumers at once, and they survive regardless, so a per-individual cut would not change the conclusion. The consumer's dependence on prey is on the presence of prey material as a catalytic substrate (cat = kr c_a q^2 (1 - r)); removing all prey (the claim's E fork) removes the substrate, which is presence. Consumer splits are the host's splits (15 of 18), as c61 found on seed 57 (27 of 28).
